Chapter 7013: Parting Hook, Xiaolou Tingxue

Chapter 7013: Parting Hook, Xiaolou Tingxue

The hidden hands attracted the most attention. Was he hiding a weapon, an artifact, or nothing at all? Of course, none dared to risk their lives to satiate their curiosity.

“Parting Hook, Xialou Tingxue.” The golden immortals were alarmed to see him. [1]

“Is it Tingxue or Tingyu?” Someone asked a friend. [2]

“Tingxue, or Tingyu, I’m not sure.” The friend said.

The actual name couldn’t be confirmed, only the title. Of course, this didn’t really matter since it might not be his real name.

Immortals didn’t know what started this. After all, despite his young appearance, he was one of the oldest immortals in Heavenrealm. He was one of the five primordial immortals belonging to Epoch Dawn.

Some knew that Parting Hook was the name of his weapon. However, he used a saber slash just now.

There was another rumor of him listening to blood, not snow. [3]

According to a forgotten tale, perhaps a hundred million years ago, an arrogant immortal from a prestigious lineage made fun of his hands.

He cut this immortal down and entered the lineage, slaying all of its immortals. He then sat inside a pavilion and listened to the flow of their blood. [4]

From then on, no one saw his hands again, or they would be doomed. His hands must have been strange or aberrant somehow, hence his decision to start Foreign Alliance. It was meant to recruit anyone with something unique or strange.

For example, Snowdragon was an aberrant breed that suffered discrimination. He didn’t care for Amethyst and Till Ancestor, only her.

“Parting Hook...” Autumn Wind murmured.

“You are not worthy.” Xialou Tingxue glared in the wind’s direction and saw through the stealth.

“Senior, our race has nothing but respect for you.” The two fortress brothers spoke.

“Save the flattery until after you survive.” Xialou Tingxue said.

“Senior, we do not wish to oppose you...” Silver Machine Immortal said.

“But you wanted to kill our alliance’s member.” Xialou Tingxue said.

They naturally wanted to kill her since she was stubborn. Alas, there was no point in reasoning with him.

“Brother, if they have offended you, they will apologize to you and Fairy Snowdragon.” A metallic voice sounded, immense enough to sink the whole world.

“Bam!” A shadow smashed straight into the ground.

When people took a closer look, they saw a bronze ingot exuding a primordial aura emanating from the start of the world. It could be the first piece of metal in existence, capable of stopping anything.

“Immortal Bronze.” Xialou Tingyue became serious.

“Ancestor.” The two brothers were happy to see the ingot.

Other immortals bowed upon seeing it.

1. A reference to Gu Long’s seven weapons. ☜

2. Ting is listen, Xue is snow, Yu is rain ☜

3. Blood and snow are both Xue ☜

4. Xiaolou is pavilion ☜
